scope: offline Meta-HPO challenger shortlist only; no score, MC1, admission, portfolio, live, or exchange authority
supersedes_for_future_independent_banks_: GateProxy_P0_Ridge may remain the frozen transition shortlist for the already-defined work; it is not refitted or retroactively re-ranked by this protocol.

decision.incumbent: external anchor; it always receives full strict MC1 plus constrained-portfolio confirmation and is never proxy-ranked against challengers
decision.candidate_question: Does this new challenger beat the fixed incumbent after the identical strict MC1, dual-admission, and constrained chronological portfolio replay?
decision.primary_target: P(BeatIncumbent = 1 | cheap challenger and incumbent-relative diagnostics)
decision.prohibition: The proxy may select confirmation candidates only. It may never promote a Meta trial, alter an incumbent, or influence live inference.

same_evaluation_contract_required: identical target-free candidate identities and base route
identical policy-label source and resolved-label availability
identical Current and BCF MC1 maps and dual-admission threshold
one common chronological portfolio state and identical execution policy
beat_incumbent_label.note: These are predeclared conservative selection tolerances, not a live objective and not fitted on the successor bank.

margin_of_victory.construction: robustly standardize candidate-minus-incumbent deltas using only prior completed independent banks, then sum the declared components
components: positive net EV per trade delta
margin_of_victory.downside_rule: Any hard breach of the BeatIncumbent downside or volume floor forces BeatIncumbent = 0 regardless of MarginOfVictory.

incumbent_relative: each compatible absolute diagnostic as challenger_minus_incumbent
forbidden: full downstream MC1 or portfolio outcomes from the new bank
future target or policy outcome fields
a proxy score as an inference feature

fit_and_validation.unit_of_independence: HPO bank, not trial. Nearby configurations from one bank must never split across train and validation.
fit_and_validation.validation: leave-one-independent-HPO-bank-out; time-respecting when banks are chronological
fit_and_validation.minimum_evidence_before_fit: three completed independent banks containing a fixed-incumbent comparison; otherwise retain P0 only as a transition shortlist and collect labels
success_metrics: Recall@3 of the best confirmed challenger
fit_and_validation.no_same_bank_retuning: Proxy coefficients, outcome tolerances, and feature transformations are frozen before the successor bank is scored.

confirmation_funnel.compute_permitting_control: one high-uncertainty or descriptor-diverse challenger, selected without access to the new bank's downstream results
confirmation_funnel.advancement: only a fully matched strict MC1 plus constrained-portfolio result can beat the incumbent
